logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Playful, Seductive)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Ironical)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Intense, Whispering)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Name your price.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Unsupervised. In your hands alone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Grave)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: For as long as it holds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Softly, Teasing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Chuckle, Resigned)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Murmuring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: In another room no one uses?

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Whispering)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Perhaps I like rooms no one uses.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Low, Carnal)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
